blocks.text: Yeh Unit 14 (Vectors in Space) ke poore unit se practice MCQs hain, unit ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah, jis mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.
14.1 Vectors (Recall)

blocks.prompt:
1 Which one of the following is a vector quantity?
(In mein se kaun si quantity vector hai?)
blocks.explanation: Vector ki magnitude (miqdaar) aur direction (simt) dono hoti hain. Momentum ki simt hoti hai; speed, work aur temperature sirf magnitude rakhte hain, is liye scalar hain.

book_ref.quote: a vector is a quantity that has both magnitude and direction

blocks.prompt:
2 The magnitude of the plane vector \(\underline{u} = [5, -12]\) is:
(Plane vector \(\underline{u} = [5, -12]\) ki magnitude kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: we define the magnitude as the distance of the point

blocks.prompt:
3 If the vectors \([a, 6]\) and \([2, 3]\) are parallel, then \(a\) equals:
(Agar vectors \([a, 6]\) aur \([2, 3]\) parallel hon to \(a\) kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: Parallel ka matlab \([a, 6] = c[2, 3]\). \(6 = 3c\) se \(c = 2\), is liye \(a = 2 \times 2 = 4\).

book_ref.quote: Two vectors are parallel if and only if they are non-zero scalar multiples of each other

blocks.text: 14.1.1 Rectangular Coordinate System in Space

blocks.prompt:
4 In the right-hand rule for the axes in space, the fingers of the right hand point along the positive x-axis and curl toward the positive y-axis. The thumb then points along the:
(Space ke axes ke right-hand rule mein right hand ki ungliyan positive x-axis ki taraf hon aur positive y-axis ki taraf mudein. Phir angootha kis taraf hoga?)
blocks.explanation: Right-hand rule ke mutabiq ungliyan +x se +y ki taraf mudein to angootha +z ki taraf hota hai.

book_ref.quote: These axes are also labeled in accordance with the right-hand rule.

blocks.prompt:
5 The point \((0, -3, 0)\) lies on the:
(Point \((0, -3, 0)\) kahan waqe hai?)
blocks.explanation: Is ke x aur z coordinates 0 hain; sirf y-axis ke saath faasla hai, is liye point y-axis par hai.

book_ref.quote: then the point P is written with a unique triple of real numbers

blocks.text: 14.1.2 Concept of a Vector in Space

blocks.prompt:

(Set \(R^{3}\) kya hai?)

options.text: real numbers ke tamam ordered pairs ka set

blocks.explanation: \(R^{3} = \{(x, y, z) : x, y, z \in R\}\), yani real numbers ki tamam ordered triples (tarteeb wali teen ki tolian); isay 3-dimensional space kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: is called 3-dimensional space

blocks.explanation: \(|3\underline{i} + 4\underline{k}| = 5\); unit vector \(\frac{1}{5}(3\underline{i} + 4\underline{k})\) ko 10 se zarb dein: \(6\underline{i} + 8\underline{k}\).

book_ref.quote: A unit vector is defined as a vector whose magnitude is unity.

blocks.explanation: \(|\underline{i} + 2\underline{j} + 2\underline{k}| = 3\), is liye \(\frac{1}{3}(\underline{i} + 2\underline{j} + 2\underline{k})\) ki magnitude 1 hai. Baqi teeno ki magnitude 1 nahin.

book_ref.quote: A unit vector is defined as a vector whose magnitude is unity.

blocks.explanation: Scalar ka vectors ke jama par phailna distributive property hai; har component mein \(a(p + q) = ap + aq\).
